data.one_liner: Connects AI agents directly to your running app for automated testing and inspection via MCP.
data.what_it_does: Give your AI agent eyes and hands inside your Flutter app across 10 platforms. Connects any AI agent via MCP, allowing it to tap buttons, type text, scroll, and take screenshots using zero test code.
use_when: You want AI agents to autonomously explore and test your app
You want to inspect or test your app using plain English prompts via MCP-compatible AI tools
You want cross-platform app inspection and automation without writing traditional test code
avoid_when: You require traditional deterministic unit or widget testing frameworks
You are not using an AI workflow or Model Context Protocol server setup
strengths: Integrates with major AI platforms via MCP (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Windsurf, etc.)
Supports 10 platforms including Flutter mobile, web, and desktop
weaknesses: Depends on external AI agents and MCP servers for full capabilities
Not a replacement for traditional automated test assertions and unit tests
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_skill to your app initialization and configure your AI tool's MCP settings.

alternatives.name: patrol_mcp
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative MCP integration for Flutter testing if you prefer Patrol-based flows.
